verdict.rationale: Orrick Tech Studio is a self-service web product with interactive forms and document generators, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no assistant users can delegate tasks to. The GenAI Policy Builder and the AI resources are about governing and adopting AI, not an in-product agent, so they are adjacent at most and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
